title: The Create a Space draft link secret is documented, so it can be set apart from the unsubscribe secret

source.ref: Feature-path wiring scan 2026-11-18 (project thread: Verify every feature path end to end)

detail:
draft-io.ts signs the come-back links in Create a Space draft emails with CREATE_SPACE_DRAFT_SECRET, falling back to UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET. The name was missing from .env.example, so no operator could know to set it, and rotating the unsubscribe secret silently voids every open draft link. Every other secret and switch the scan checked (182 names, all webhooks, all 43 crons) is documented and read.

DONE 2026-11-18: .env.example lists CREATE_SPACE_DRAFT_SECRET with its fallback.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
